-- Final query with rounding
WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        t.calendar_year,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as monthly_total
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN channels ch ON s.channel_id = ch.channel_id
    JOIN promotions p ON s.promo_id = p.promo_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
        AND p.promo_total_id = 1
        AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
        AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    GROUP BY t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number
),
sales_2019 AS (
    SELECT calendar_month_number, monthly_total as s2019
    FROM monthly_sales WHERE calendar_year = 2019
),
sales_2020 AS (
    SELECT calendar_month_number, monthly_total as s2020
    FROM monthly_sales WHERE calendar_year = 2020
),
projected_2021 AS (
    SELECT 
        s2019.calendar_month_number,
        ((s2020.s2020 - s2019.s2019) / s2019.s2019) * s2020.s2020 + s2020.s2020 as projected_sales
    FROM sales_2019 s2019
    JOIN sales_2020 s2020 ON s2019.calendar_month_number = s2020.calendar_month_number
),
with_currency AS (
    SELECT 
        p.calendar_month_number,
        ROUND(p.projected_sales * COALESCE(c.to_us, 1.0), 2) as projected_usd
    FROM projected_2021 p
    LEFT JOIN currency c ON c.country = 'France' AND c.year = 2021 AND c.month = p.calendar_month_number
)
SELECT 
    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY projected_usd) as median_projected_usd
FROM with_currency
